reviews.title: Great idea software quality
reviews.text: Great idea and functionality. Occasional but extremely frustrating crashes losing workout and changes. Timer does not always ding. It just crashed during a long workout. Gurrrrr…

reviews.title: Deletes logged info
reviews.text: If I exit out of the app in the middle of a workout, 99% of the time it deletes the typed info I log. Pretty irritating.
